_comment: Direct control of the heir: walking, the following camera, what blocks the way and the view, and how close you must be to look at or speak with someone.

walk._: Speeds are meters per real second; the heir walks at the same pace at any game speed (paused = standing still).

scan._: The Sovereign's Eye works on someone you can see within 'range' meters; talking needs 'talk_range'. Buildings block the view.

_obstacles: Collision radius (meters) for props and tree trunks. Buildings use their footprint.
